svg.aria-label: A Merkle inclusion proof. A client trusts only the root hash, for example from a signed log head. To prove that block C is in the dataset, the server sends block C plus two sibling hashes: H(D) and H(AB). The client hashes C to get H(C), combines it with H(D) to get H(CD), combines H(AB) with H(CD) to get a root, and checks that it equals the trusted root. For a million blocks the proof is only about 20 hashes, because the tree is 20 levels deep.

svg.text: proof size = tree depth: ~20 hashes for 1M blocks
